lines.x: Binance has begun restoring cryptocurrency withdrawals globally, including across African markets, after covering 95% of assets stolen in a $6.3 billion cyberattack that triggered $3.6 billion in customer withdrawals.
Hackers utilized fake job advertisements to trick a Binance engineer into downloading malware, enabling a $2.5 billion crypto drain.
Binance customers have withdrawn billions from their accounts following a USD 6.3 billion hack.
Binance saw customer outflows stabilise as the cryptocurrency exchange returned online following a $6.3 billion heist that intensified scrutiny over digital asset safety.
